Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt 76802df5e54a5566072503ef9d1e37c5: Knack d6 face3 raises16→19, turns failed proficient check into success at DC18, spend Psi die4/6→3/6. Past Life d6 face2 raises19→21, below DC23, consume PastLife2/3→1/3. No new d20, no additional features. Final21 meets DC18 but not DC23. Tavosk elects to acknowledge his own paid private inspection-information service in general terms: 'There are people who pay me privately for information before the berth inspections are announced. Knowing what is coming gives a carrier time to make his own arrangements.' He distinguishes this from changing the law, then declines to offer specific fees or terms until he understands V's actual cargo and commercial needs: 'But before I discuss terms with you, I would need to know what sort of business you intend to bring me.' This is a voluntary firsthand admission consistent with fixed delegate role; no specific named payer or payment amount, confirmed future inspection, illegal agreement, document, guarantee of immunity, or new appointment disclosed. V, Mara, Cirren and Fenar hear it firsthand; Desen not yet informed of afternoon statements. V has made no actual commercial commitment or revealed Watch evidence. Await V response in same office. No other resource, clock or custody changes.
